# Known Climate Unknown Weather
```{r}
profit_kcuw <- rbind(profit_c1,profit_c2,profit_c3, profit_c4)
crop_yield_kcuw <- rbind(crop_yield_c1,crop_yield_c2,crop_yield_c3, crop_yield_c4)
water_invest_kcuw <- c(water_invest_c1, water_invest_c2, water_invest_c3, water_invest_c4)
elc_invest_kcuw <- c(elc_invest_c1, elc_invest_c2, elc_invest_c3, elc_invest_c4)
water_kcuw <- rbind(water_c1, water_c2, water_c3, water_c4)
elc_kcuw <- rbind(elc_c1, elc_c2, elc_c3, elc_c4)
```

```{r}
elc_invest_stoch <- elc_invest_c0

```








```{r}
# Profit Stat pi


profit_pi_mean <- mean(profit_pi$profit)
profit_pi_sd <- sd(profit_pi$profit)
profit_pi_t <- -qt(0.025, df = (nrow(profit_pi)-1) )
profit_pi_se <- profit_pi_sd / sqrt((nrow(profit_pi)-1))
profit_pi_h <- profit_pi_t * profit_pi_se

profit_pi_mean
profit_pi_sd
profit_pi_t
profit_pi_se
profit_pi_h
```

# Putting Together Dataframes

## Objective Functions and Figures

```{r}
scenario_yearly_avg_trad <- tibble(sim = c('Perfect Information', 'Known Climate, Unknown Weather', 'Stochastic', 'Expected Value' ), 
# Profit                    
       profit_MM = c(mean(profit_pi$profit), mean(profit_kcuw$profit), mean(profit_stoch$profit), mean(profit_ev$profit) ),
#Crop Yield
       crop_yield_tonne = c(mean(crop_yield_pi$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_kcuw$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_stoch$crop_yield) , mean(crop_yield_ev$crop_yield)),
#Precipitation
       precip_cm = c(mean(precips_c0), mean(precips_c0), mean(precips_c0), mean(precips_c0) ),
# Water investment
       alt_water_cap_cm = c(mean(water_invest_pi$invest_water), mean(water_invest_kcuw), water_invest_stoch, water_invest_ev),
# Electricity Investment
       alt_elc_cap_kW = c(mean(elc_invest_pi$invest_elc), mean(elc_invest_kcuw), elc_invest_stoch, elc_invest_ev),       
# Total Water Use
       water_cm = c(mean(water_pi$water_depth), mean(water_kcuw$water_depth), mean(water_stoch$water_depth), mean(water_ev$water_depth) ),
# Total Electricity Use
       elc_prod_MWh = c(mean(elc_pi$elc_prod), mean(elc_kcuw$elc_prod), mean(elc_stoch$elc_prod), mean(elc_ev$elc_prod) )  ) %>% 
# Unit Conversions
  mutate(crop_yield_tonne = crop_yield_tonne * 200) %>%
  mutate(elc_prod_MWh = elc_prod_MWh / 1000) %>%
  mutate(profit_MM = profit_MM / 1000000)


scenario_yearly_avg_trad$sim <- ordered(scenario_yearly_avg_trad$sim, levels = c('Perfect Information', 'Known Climate, Unknown Weather', 'Stochastic', 'Expected Value'))


```


```{r}
# Sim Stats Data Frame

sim_stats_trad <- tibble(sim = c('Perfect Information', 'Known Climate, Unknown Weather', 'Stochastic', 'Expected Value'  ),
                    
                    profit_mean = c(mean(profit_pi$profit), mean(profit_kcuw$profit), mean(profit_stoch$profit), mean(profit_ev$profit) ),
                    
                    profit_sd = c(sd(profit_pi$profit), sd(profit_kcuw$profit), sd(profit_stoch$profit), sd(profit_ev$profit) ),
                    
                    profit_t = c(profit_pi_t, profit_kcuw_t, profit_stoch_t, profit_ev_t),
                    
                    profit_se = c(profit_pi_se, profit_kcuw_se, profit_stoch_se, profit_ev_se),
                    
                    profit_h = c(profit_pi_h, profit_kcuw_h, profit_stoch_h, profit_ev_h),
                    
                    crop_yield_mean = c(mean(crop_yield_pi$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_kcuw$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_stoch$crop_yield), mean(crop_yield_ev$crop_yield) ),
                    
                    crop_yield_sd = c(sd(crop_yield_pi$crop_yield), sd(crop_yield_kcuw$crop_yield), sd(crop_yield_stoch$crop_yield), sd(crop_yield_ev$crop_yield) ),
                    
                    crop_yield_t = c(crop_yield_pi_t, crop_yield_kcuw_t, crop_yield_stoch_t, crop_yield_ev_t),
                    
                    crop_yield_se = c(crop_yield_pi_se, crop_yield_kcuw_se, crop_yield_stoch_se, crop_yield_ev_se),
                    
                    crop_yield_h = c(crop_yield_pi_h, crop_yield_kcuw_h, crop_yield_stoch_h, crop_yield_ev_h) )
                    
                    
sim_stats_trad$sim <- ordered(sim_stats_trad$sim, levels = c('Perfect Information', 'Known Climate, Unknown Weather', 'Stochastic', 'Expected Value'  ))









value_of_solns_DML <- tibble(Climate_Probability = c('Equally Likely'), 
       Value_of_Known_Weather = as.numeric(scenario_yearly_avg_trad[1,2] - scenario_yearly_avg_trad[2,2]) * 1000000 , 
       Value_of_Perfect_Information = as.numeric(scenario_yearly_avg_trad[1,2] - scenario_yearly_avg_trad[3,2]) * 1000000, 
       Value_of_Stochastic_Solution = as.numeric(scenario_yearly_avg_trad[3,2] - scenario_yearly_avg_trad[4,2]) * 1000000)
```
